lines.en: label toukadorm5:
scene dorm2
I knock on Touka’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲开 Touka 的门，等她应声。

lines.en: I saw Yasu leaving the building on my way in, so at least I’m going in there knowing that I won’t have to figure out how to deal with her this time around.
lines.zh: 进来时我看见 Yasu 离开了楼，所以这次至少不用费心琢磨怎么应付她了。

lines.en: If Touka even lets me in, that is.
lines.zh: 当然，前提是 Touka 肯放我进去。

lines.en: I realize she’s been starting to warm up to me, but it’s not like she particularly likes me very much yet.
lines.zh: 我意识到她对我渐渐有了好感，但也说不上有多喜欢我。

lines.en: And without her roommate being around to provide whatever...sense of comfort someone like Yasu can provide, she may very well be completely opposed to this.
lines.zh: 而且没有她室友在场、提供 Yasu 那种人所能提供的……安全感，她很可能会完全反对让我进门。

lines.en: : The door is unlocked. You may enter.
lines.zh: : 门没锁。你可以进来。

lines.en: Or she may not be opposed at all and will just invite me in without question.
lines.zh: 又或者她一点都不反对，二话不说就请我进去。

lines.en: Nice.
lines.zh: 不错。

lines.en: scene black
scene toukapjs1
I push open the door to find Touka dressed {i}significantly{/i} down compared to her usual self, and I can’t help but be taken aback for a moment.
lines.zh: 我推开门，发现 Touka 穿得比平常朴素{i}太多{/i}，一时间有点愣住了。

lines.en: Not just because she looks like an almost entirely different person, {i}but because she is fucking stacked. Holy shit.{/i}
lines.zh: 不光因为她看着几乎像换了个人，{i}更因为她身材是真他妈有料。我的天。{/i}

lines.en: : Did you forget something?
lines.zh: : 你是不是忘了什么东西？

lines.en: : Is that your way of asking me to compliment you?
lines.zh: : 这是你拐弯抹角让我夸你吗？

lines.en: scene toukapjs2
: Wait, you’re not Yasu.
lines.zh: : 等等，你不是 Yasu。

lines.en: : I am not.
lines.zh: : 我不是。

lines.en: : Yasu knocks on her own door?
lines.zh: : Yasu 会敲自己房间的门？

lines.en: scene toukapjs1
: Yasu does many strange things. I’ve decided it’s best if I just stop questioning them altogether.
lines.zh: : Yasu 干过很多怪事。我已经认定，最好干脆一概不再追问。

lines.en: : What brings you here, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你来这儿有什么事，Sensei？

lines.en: : Before that, don’t you want to take a second to get all embarrassed about being seen in your pajamas by a commoner?
lines.zh: : 在那之前，你不想先花点时间，为「被一介平民看见你穿睡衣」而难为情一下吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly. I have a very nice body, as you may have noticed.
lines.zh: : 不太想。我的身材很好——你大概也注意到了。

lines.en: : Oh I have definitely noticed.
lines.zh: : 哦，我绝对注意到了。

lines.en: scene toukapjs3
: Oh. So you {i}want{/i} me to be embarrassed. That’s how it is.
lines.zh: : 哦。原来你是{i}想{/i}让我难为情。这么回事啊。

lines.en: : I mean, a slight blush wouldn’t kill you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，稍微脸红一下又不会死。

lines.en: scene toukapjs1
: Well I apologize, but I will not be blushing or awkwardly avoiding your gaze tonight, for I am the picture of perfect health for a girl my age.
lines.zh: : 好吧，抱歉。但我今晚既不打算脸红，也不打算别扭地躲你的目光——因为以我这年纪的女孩来说，我健康得堪称典范。

lines.en: : Well, you...certainly take after your mother in at least one area.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，你在……至少某方面确实很像你母亲。

lines.en: : Is that any way for an educational professional to be talking to a student?
lines.zh: : 一个教育工作者能这么跟学生说话吗？

lines.en: : Not really. But Tsubasa already said you have to listen to me and-
lines.zh: : 不太能。不过 Tsubasa 已经说了你得听我的，而且——

lines.en: : I know what she said.
lines.zh: : 我知道她说了什么。

lines.en: : And if you’ve come here to belittle me some more or hold her words over my head, please have the decency to do it some other time.
lines.zh: : 而且，你要是来这儿是想接着贬低我、或拿她的话压我，那请你换个时间再来。

lines.en: : What if I’m here to say a bunch of nice things about you instead?
lines.zh: : 那我要是来夸你一堆好话呢？

lines.en: : You? Act out of genuine kindness rather than self interest or curiosity?
lines.zh: : 你？出于真心善意、而不是私利或好奇行事？

lines.en: : I haven’t been here very long, but even I find that statement laughable, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿待得不久，可连我都觉得这话好笑，Sensei。

lines.en: scene toukapjs4
: Though...it would make me feel a {i}little{/i} better, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 不过……我想，那样我确实会好受{i}一点{/i}。

lines.en: : Is something wrong? You seem less...pompous than normal tonight.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你今晚看着没平常那么……高傲。

lines.en: scene toukapjs5
: Do you expect lacing your concern with ridicule to gain you any favor in this conversation?
lines.zh: : 你以为把关心裹在嘲讽里，能在这场谈话里给你加分？

lines.en: : Look at me for a moment. Not at my chest, but at me.
lines.zh: : 看着我一会儿。别看我的胸，看我。

lines.en: : Does it {i}look{/i} like something is wrong?
lines.zh: : {i}看{/i}着像出事了吗？

lines.en: : I mean, kind of. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是有点像。对。

lines.en: : Then it is safe to assume that something is wrong. There’s no need to ask.
lines.zh: : 那就可以断定出事了。没必要问。

lines.en: scene toukapjs6
: How unfortunate that the one area I hoped you’d handle differently is the sole area that you approach the same way as everyone else.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我唯一希望你「换个方式对待」的地方，偏偏是你处理得跟别人一模一样的地方。

lines.en: : Do you want to be left alone or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不是想一个人待着？

lines.en: scene toukapjs7
: If that’s what you think is best.
lines.zh: : 要是你觉得那样最好，那就行。

lines.en: : Though, if you’d like to keep me company instead, I won’t reject it.
lines.zh: : 不过，要是你反而想陪着我，我也不会拒绝。

lines.en: : It’s not like anyone else is going to be knocking on the door anytime soon.
lines.zh: : 反正短期内也不会有别人来敲门。

lines.en: Ahh, so this is more of that.
lines.zh: 啊，原来又是这么回事。

lines.en: I guess it would be exhausting or depressing or whatever else you want to call it if you go from having the world served to you on a silver platter to browsing the Internet all by yourself each night.
lines.zh: 我想，从「全世界都盛在银盘里端到你面前」，到「每晚独自一人刷网页」，这落差大概会让人精疲力尽、或者心灰意冷、或者随你怎么叫它。

lines.en: : Still having a hard time blending in?
lines.zh: : 还是很难融入？

lines.en: scene toukapjs8
: May I stand?
lines.zh: : 我可以站起来吗？

lines.en: : It’s impolite for me to let this conversation carry on while appearing so informal. I should be facing you, at the bare minimum.
lines.zh: : 让这场谈话以我这么不得体的姿态继续，是很失礼的。我至少该面对着你。

lines.en: : You don’t need to handle everything so formally. If you want to sit, that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 你用不着事事都这么正式。你要想坐着，也行。

lines.en: : If I wanted to sit, I would not have asked if it was okay for me to stand.
lines.zh: : 我若想坐着，就不会问能不能站起来了。

lines.en: : So, with that in mind, may I stand?
lines.zh: : 所以，鉴于此，我可以站起来吗？

lines.en: : I...I guess?
lines.zh: : 我……行吧？

lines.en: scene toukapjs7
: Thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢。

lines.en: scene black
Touka closes out a window on her laptop to prevent me from seeing it. But I highly doubt it was anything unsavory based on her posture.
lines.zh: Touka 关掉了笔记本上的一个窗口，免得让我看见。不过看她的姿势，我很确定那不是什么见不得人的东西。

lines.en: She straightens out her tanktop and pats the sides of her leggings to smooth out any creases before taking her place a foot or two in front of me.
lines.zh: 她整了整背心，又抚平紧身裤两侧的褶皱，才在我面前一两英尺处站定。

lines.en: scene toukapjs9
: To answer your question, yes. I’m still having a hard time blending in.
lines.zh: : 回答你的问题：是的。我还是很难融入。

lines.en: : I realize that I am likely just impatient, but it is not a good feeling walking into class each morning and knowing that you are being judged despite doing absolutely nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 我知道多半只是我没耐心，可每天早上走进教室、明知自己什么都没做却在被人评判——这滋味不好受。

lines.en: : I know I say strange things from time to time that “normal” people would laugh at, but I have yet to say enough to any of the other girls to warrant laughter whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 我知道自己偶尔会说些「正常」人听了会发笑的怪话，可我对其他女孩说的话，还远没到该被笑的程度。

lines.en: scene toukapjs10
: I probably would have been better off if none of them had a history at Kumon-mi Academy.
lines.zh: : 要是她们谁都没有在公文美学园的「前科」，我大概会好过些。

lines.en: : But the fact that some did...means that I arrive here with not just a head full of hope and a heart full of naivety-
lines.zh: : 可偏偏有些人有……这意味着我来到这儿时，不光带着一脑子的憧憬和一颗天真的心——

lines.en: : But an extensive background of preconceived notions and expectations that were not swallowed along with everything else the sinkhole claimed.
lines.zh: : 还背着一大堆先入为主的成见和期待——这些可没跟别的东西一起被「天坑」吞掉。

lines.en: : I did not have any friends in my last[school], as I’m sure you know.
lines.zh: : 我在上一家[学校]没有任何朋友——这你肯定知道。

lines.en: : I attended my own classes and had my own teachers, and communicating with me in general wasn’t prohibited or anything like that, but...
lines.zh: : 我上的是我自己的课，有我自己的老师，而且跟我说话也并没被禁止之类的，只是……

lines.en: : It didn’t seem like anyone ever wanted to do it.
lines.zh: : 好像从来没人「想」跟我说话。

lines.en: : Like they saw me as some girl that they could get in trouble for approaching, even though I’d smile and wave at every single student who walked past my window.
lines.zh: : 好像在他们眼里，我是个「接近就会惹上麻烦」的女孩——尽管我会对每一个从我窗前走过的学生微笑、挥手。

lines.en: scene toukapjs11
: I’m sure that me complaining like this means absolutely nothing to you...especially now that I know how hard some people in our class have it.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，我这么抱怨对你来说毫无意义……尤其现在我知道了班上有些人过得多艰难。

lines.en: : But the fact that I can still feel people looking at me and immediately jumping to the idea of “it must be so easy to be her” stings more than I ever imagined it would.
lines.zh: : 可只要我还感觉得到别人看我、并立刻断定「当这种人肯定很轻松」，那种刺痛就比我想象的厉害得多。

lines.en: : I do not expect you to numb that sting.
lines.zh: : 我不指望你替我止住这刺痛。

lines.en: : And I do not particularly expect you to care.
lines.zh: : 也不怎么指望你在乎。

lines.en: : But I do ask that you, at the bare minimum, acknowledge that I am not perfect or unwavering.
lines.zh: : 但我至少请你承认：我并不完美，也不是永远坚不动摇。

lines.en: : I am a {i}real{/i} girl with {i}real{/i} feelings.
lines.zh: : 我是个{i}有血有肉{/i}、有{i}真实{/i}感情的女孩。

lines.en: scene toukapjs12
: And I would very much like {i}real{/i} friends so I don’t have to spend so much time sitting in my room by myself.
lines.zh: : 而且我非常想要{i}真正{/i}的朋友，这样就不用老是一个人坐在房间里了。

lines.en: : You’re crying again.
lines.zh: : 你又哭了。

lines.en: : Yes. I have been crying a lot lately. Please stop pointing it out.
lines.zh: : 是。我最近老哭。请别再指出来了。

lines.en: : I don’t have a problem with it or anything. I actually think it’s cute.
lines.zh: : 我倒不反感。我其实觉得挺可爱的。

lines.en: scene toukapjs13
: My sadness is not cute! It is sad! Feel bad for me!
lines.zh: : 我的难过才不可爱！那是难过！同情我！

lines.en: : No, I just mean it’s nice being reminded that you {i}are{/i} an actual person and not some rich girl stereotype like I thought you were at first.
lines.zh: : 不，我是说，能被提醒「你{i}是{/i}个真实的人、而不是我起初以为的那种富家女刻板印象」，挺好的。

lines.en: scene toukapjs14
: I did some research on the stereotypical views people have of girls like me and can confirm that, to at least some extent, I fit the bill depressingly well.
lines.zh: : 我去查过人们对「我这种女孩」的刻板印象，可以证实：至少在一定程度上，我符合得令人沮丧。

lines.en: : But simply not knowing how things work around here does not make me any less deserving than anyone else.
lines.zh: : 可仅仅因为「不懂这儿的规矩」，并不代表我比谁不配。

lines.en: scene toukapjs15
: But...{i}ahem{/i}!
: I should not be airing out those worries in front of you.
lines.zh: : 我不该在你面前倾诉这些烦恼。

lines.en: : I have learned through experience that letting my emotions get the best of me scares off those who have been selected to teach me.
lines.zh: : 我从经验里学到，让情绪失控，会把那些被派来「教」我的人吓跑。

lines.en: : So you’ve gone from trying to get me fired to fighting off tears in an effort to keep me. And in just a few short dorm visits, too.
lines.zh: : 所以你从「想让我被开除」，变成了「强忍眼泪想留住我」。而且这才短短几次宿舍造访。

lines.en: : I have given you the benefits of many doubts and will continue to do that until I no longer find it constructive.
lines.zh: : 我给过你很多次「姑且信你」的机会，在我还觉得有意义之前，我会一直给下去。

lines.en: scene toukapjs16
: And I will admit that I felt myself gradually slipping toward just that, but airing out more of my worries tonight has quelled the storm for at least the time being.
lines.zh: : 而且我得承认，我刚才确实感觉自己渐渐往「没意义」那边滑，但今晚多倾诉了些烦恼，至少眼下把这场风暴压下去了。

lines.en: : It was also very nice of you to not interrupt me during my explanation.
lines.zh: : 你刚才没打断我，这点也很难得。

lines.en: : I can be serious when I have to be. Besides, it’s weird seeing you not acting...weird.
lines.zh: : 该认真的时候我也能认真。再说，看你没表现得……怪里怪气，还挺不习惯的。

lines.en: : I’m sure it came across as quite a shock at first, but I’m already feeling a little better now that I’ve gotten to talk about it.
lines.zh: : 我敢说一开始听着挺震惊的，不过能说开之后，我现在已经感觉好些了。

lines.en: : Yasu and I have been doing a little better too, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: : 顺带一提，我跟 Yasu 也处得好点了——万一你好奇的话。

lines.en: : Oh yeah?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？

lines.en: : We’re still nowhere near companions, but I no longer feel as if she is going to kill me in my sleep. Which is a dramatic improvement, if I do say so myself.
lines.zh: : 离「同伴」还差得远，但至少我不再觉得她会在睡梦中杀我了。这进步可大了，不夸张。

lines.en: : Wow, you’re already braver than I am then.
lines.zh: : 哇，那你已经比我勇敢了。

lines.en: scene toukapjs17
: Hahah! I suppose I am.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！我想也是。

lines.en: scene toukapjs18
: Okay. Now that the sad part is out of the way, I suppose there’s no longer a reason to stand.
lines.zh: : 好了。既然难过的部分说完了，我想也没必要再站着了。

lines.en: : Let’s take a seat and talk a little more if you don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 不介意的话，我们坐下再聊会儿。

lines.en: : I have plenty of time to do this because I am what most people here would call a “loser.”
lines.zh: : 我有的是时间干这个，因为按这儿大多数人的标准，我是个「废物」。

lines.en: scene toukapjs19
Touka sits down on an expensive looking ottoman and I find a place beside her.
lines.zh: Touka 在一张看着就贵的脚凳上坐下，我在她旁边找了个位置。

lines.en: There isn’t much room on it, so we need to sit relatively close together. But she is the one who chose this seat and so she is the one that must pay.
lines.zh: 凳子没多大地方，我们得挨得相当近。不过是她选的这座位，所以这「代价」该她付。

lines.en: I am absolutely not deterred at all from being so close to such an...endowed [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: 我绝对、完全没有因为挨着这么一位……丰满的[未成年]女孩而心慌。

lines.en: Yup. Feeling totally normal right now.
lines.zh: 对。此刻感觉完全正常。
: 那么……

lines.en: : Now what do we do?
lines.zh: : 接下来我们干嘛？

lines.en: : We can keep talking about you, I guess. We seem to be on a roll in that regard.
lines.zh: : 我想，可以继续聊你。这方面我们好像挺顺的。

lines.en: : Is there anything in particular you’re interested in hearing?
lines.zh: : 你有什么特别想听的吗？

lines.en: : I’m going to preface this by saying I mean it in the least offensive way possible-
lines.zh: : 我先声明，我说这话绝无冒犯之意——

lines.en: : Oh, wonderful. What a great sign.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。多好的兆头。

lines.en: : ...But was there anything difficult about your life outside of Kumon-mi Academy?
lines.zh: : ……不过，你在公文美学园之外的生活，有什么难处吗？

lines.en: : I know you mentioned losing teachers and have an apparent disposition to the word “princess-”
lines.zh: : 我知道你提过「气跑老师」，而且你显然对「公主」这个词有种情结——

lines.en: : But you want to know what the worst of the worst is.
lines.zh: : 但你想知道的是「最难的那部分」。

lines.en: : Right.
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Yes, I suppose I would also be curious if I came across someone who I imagined was simply breezing through life without any issues whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想，要是我碰到一个我以为「一辈子顺风顺水、毫无烦恼」的人，我也会好奇。

lines.en: scene toukapjs20
: But the question you ask can not really be answered in a simple manner, as it’s been something I’ve been dealing with since I was born.
lines.zh: : 但你问的这个问题，没法用一句话答清，因为它是我打出生起就一直在应对的东西。

lines.en: : Please don’t tell me you’re going to admit to having some sort of terminal disease now that we're finally starting to get closer.
lines.zh: : 求你别告诉我，在我们好不容易走近之后，你要坦白自己得了什么绝症。

lines.en: scene toukapjs21
: I’m afraid that’s exactly what I’m about to do.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我正要这么做。

lines.en: : What-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: : The disease of being born a woman to someone who, more than anything, wanted a male heir.
lines.zh: : 一种「生而为女、而父亲偏偏最想要个男性继承人」的病。

lines.en: : Jesus, don’t call that a disease. I thought you were dying for a second.
lines.zh: : 天啊，别管那叫「病」。我还以为你快死了。

lines.en: scene toukapjs22
: The Tsukioka family is very much one of tradition.
lines.zh: : 月冈家非常讲究传统。

lines.en: : We’re wealthy now due to the entrepreneurial spirit of my grandfather-
lines.zh: : 我们家如今有钱，是拜我祖父的创业精神所赐——

lines.en: : But even before then, there were long periods of great wealth for the family that can be traced all the way back to the early Edo period.
lines.zh: : 但早在他之前，这个家族就有过很多段大富大贵的时期，能一路追溯到江户时代初期。

lines.en: : And one thing that virtually every single iteration of the family held true to...was bearing no more than two children per every male figurehead.
lines.zh: : 而这个家族几乎每一代都恪守的一条规矩是……每位男性家主，最多只生两个孩子。

lines.en: : As such, the first male born to every father would go on to inherit everything possessed by them at the time of their death.
lines.zh: : 因此，每位父亲的长子，会在父亲去世时继承其名下的一切。

lines.en: : But seeing as my father has already had two daughters and will not break family tradition, that responsibility defaults to me as the first born.
lines.zh: : 可既然我父亲已经生了两个女儿、又不肯破家族传统，这份责任就落到了作为长女的我的头上。

lines.en: : Even though I’m not the gender he wished for.
lines.zh: : 尽管我不是他想要的性别。

lines.en: : And you’d call that the hardest part about your life?
lines.zh: : 而你管这个叫「你人生中最难的部分」？

lines.en: scene toukapjs23
: I was born in a very fortunate place in time to a very fortunate family.
lines.zh: : 我生在一个占尽天时地利的家庭，已经足够幸运了。

lines.en: : It’s just unfortunate that I must work harder for my father’s approval than I would have had to if I had been born looking the way he desired.
lines.zh: : 只是很不幸：要赢得我父亲的认可，我必须比「生为他想要的样子」时付出更多努力。

lines.en: : He's a good father...and he does love me.
lines.zh: : 他是个好父亲……也确实爱我。

lines.en: : But sometimes, it feels like the only way to make him proud at all is to surrender myself to the male heir of some other family with even greater power than ours.
lines.zh: : 可有时候，感觉唯一能让他骄傲的办法，就是把自己嫁给某个比我们更有权势的家族的男性继承人。

lines.en: : Of course the issue with that is that there are no males anywhere and that I absolutely would not want to get married right now.
lines.zh: : 当然，这事的麻烦在于——根本没有那样的男性，而且我现在也绝对不想结婚。

lines.en: scene toukapjs24
: Maybe one day, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，也许有一天吧。

lines.en: : I can only imagine how excited you are to be married into the Amamiya family.
lines.zh: : 我能想象，你对于自己将来「嫁进天宫家」该有多兴奋。

lines.en: scene toukapjs25
: Hah...
: Did I say something wrong?
lines.zh: : 我说错话了吗？

lines.en: : I apologize if I killed the conversation, but she seemed so excited at the prospect of settling down with you and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉把天聊死了，可她刚才说到「跟你安定下来」，看着那么兴奋，而且——

lines.en: : Didn’t I tell you to not believe anything Ayane says?
lines.zh: : 我不是叫你别信 Ayane 说的任何话吗？

lines.en: : If it was just her word, I’d understand but...
lines.zh: : 要光是她的说法，我还能理解，可是……

lines.en: : Ever since running into you two at the dojo, I felt some sort of connection.
lines.zh: : 自从在道场撞见你们俩，我就觉得你们之间有某种联系。

lines.en: : Do you mean to tell me there is nothing there?
lines.zh: : 你是想说，那儿什么都没有？

lines.en: : I mean to tell you that if there is, it doesn’t concern you. And wouldn’t be something I’d want to talk about even if it did.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是：就算有，也与你无关。而且就算与你有关，我也不愿谈。

lines.en: scene toukapjs26
: I’m very sorry...I meant no offense.
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉……我无意冒犯。

lines.en: : I was just interested in hearing a little more about how you intend to spend the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 我只是想多听听，你打算怎么度过你的余生。

lines.en: : My path is mostly clear, so...hearing how things are for those who have not been born into set courses...sometimes makes me feel rather warm inside.
lines.zh: : 我的人生道路基本已经定死了，所以……听一听那些「没有生在既定轨道」的人过得怎样……有时会让我心里暖暖的。

lines.en: : But if that’s not an area you’d like to touch on...I will respect that.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是不想谈这个……我尊重。

lines.en: : Let’s just...move onto something a little different.
lines.zh: : 那我们……换个话题吧。

lines.en: scene black
Touka’s idea of “something different” is telling me more about her family’s history which, and this might come as a surprise, {i}I’m not very interested in.{/i}
lines.zh: Touka 口中的「换个话题」，是给我讲更多她家族的历史——说来你可能不信，{i}我对这个兴趣不大{/i}。

lines.en: But she does seem to enjoy talking about it and...I do enjoy sitting next to her and {i}watching{/i} her talk about it, so I don’t try to stop her.
lines.zh: 不过她讲起这个来确实兴致勃勃，而……我也确实喜欢坐在她旁边{i}看{/i}她讲，所以我没去打断她。

lines.en: I let her talk until her mouth gets dry and she needs to get a drink from the vending machine outside.
lines.zh: 我由着她讲，讲到她口干、得去外面的自动贩卖机买喝的。

lines.en: I follow her into the hall as it’s getting late and I should probably be heading home anyway.
lines.zh: 我跟着她走进走廊——天色不早了，我反正也该回家了。

lines.en: But I don’t leave until I confirm to myself that she is still doing the vending machine power pose I taught her the other day.
lines.zh: 可我一直没走，直到亲眼确认她还在做我前几天教她的那个「贩卖机必胜 pose」。

lines.en: I’m so proud of her.
lines.zh: 我真为她骄傲。

lines.en: And so excited for her to find out from a very confused classmate that she has been making herself look like an idiot for quite some time now.
lines.zh: 而且我也很期待，等哪个一头雾水的同学告诉她：她这副蠢样已经保持好一阵子了。

lines.en: Fortunately, she’s a very cute idiot.
lines.zh: 好在，她是个很可爱的傻瓜。

lines.en: And I find myself becoming more interested in her with each passing day.
lines.zh: 而且我发现，自己一天比一天对她更感兴趣了。

$ toukadorm5 = True
{i}Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度上升到了 [touka_love]！{/i}
